title: Read-only roles may run adj lint

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261118-225932-056b, project ork, item S345:

allow adj lint --root DIR in the reviewer's sandbox, since the slice Check names it

Evidence: adj lint --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork/.worktrees/S345 was denied with "This command requires approval" while slicer check --root ran.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/perm.go:20-34` (`LocalReadOnlyAllowlist`)
- `internal/engine/perm_test.go:14-18` (`TestReadOnlyAllowlistIncludesAdjLint`)
- `internal/daemon/runner_test.go:279` (`localReadOnlyTools` and read-only launcher tests)
- `docs/design.md:2287-2295` (the read-only allowlist)
- `landed-changed/S458.md` (entry generated by `slicer changelog add`)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Owner decision adj 499 (`roles.read-only-adj-lint` = add, 2026-11-19).

- `TestReadOnlyAllowlistIncludesAdjLint` in `internal/engine/perm_test.go`: `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist()` contains `Bash(adj lint*)`. Red before the code change.
- Update `localReadOnlyTools` in `internal/daemon/runner_test.go:279` to include `Bash(adj lint*)` after `Bash(adj check*)`. The existing cloud and local read-only launcher tests must fail before the code change and pass after it. `internal/agent/claude/args_test.go` uses supplied sample lists and does not pin the engine list.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing test and see it red.
2. Add `Bash(adj lint*)` after `Bash(adj check*)` in `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist`.
3. Docs: `docs/design.md` read-only allowlist lists adj lint, citing adj 499. Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S458 --text "..."`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- A read-only role (local or cloud Claude) may run adj lint, including with --root after the subcommand.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/engine -run TestReadOnlyAllowlistIncludesAdjLint -v`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, message "S458: read-only roles may run adj lint".
